title: Nice tour of Macarena churches
text: Having already seen the Catedral de Sevilla, I was a little worried that touring four more churches in the same area might feel redundant, but it did not.  Each church was unique in its own way and Robert was a very knowledgeable and enthusiastic guide.
author: John_T

title: Amazing
text: Our guide Roberto Antonio was brilliant. He brought to life eight centuries of Spanish history and modern local culture as he walked us through beautiful churches and haunting ruins. He was engaging to our teenager as well and very accommodating of our needs and interests. His passion for history and his home are remarkable and leave an impression.
author: Jaya_A
